Title: Céline Dion returns to stage for first Paris show: 'I want to sing for you, to sing about life'
Description: With a controlled voice and a relatively understated show, the Québécois star delighted the 30,000 spectators at the Plenitude Arena just outside the French capital with a 25-song set over two hours and 15 minutes. It was her first concert in six years.

'Ordinary citizens do not want to be sent to a war with no end in sight': Russian men consider exile
Description: Amid the threat of renewed conscription, some Russian men of fighting age have purchased plane tickets and are ready to leave if a general mobilization is declared after the elections scheduled for September 18 to 20. Georgia, Armenia and Serbia are the most popular destinations.

Title: Isolated by Iran and Yemeni Houthi rebels, Saudi Arabia seeks US backing
Description: With Tehran-allied rebels seizing control of the Bab al-Mandab Strait between the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean on Thursday, and Iran blocking the Strait of Hormuz, the kingdom is at risk of losing all maritime access for its oil tankers.

Title: 2027 presidential election: Mélenchon pressures left-wing rivals at Fête de L'Humanité festival
Description: Jean-Luc Mélenchon, presidential candidate of radical-left La France Insoumise, put on a show of strength and engaged in a long-distance dual with Communist leader Fabien Roussel. Mélenchon also sought to convince crowds that he could beat Marine Le Pen.

Title: How 9/11 changed the far right
Description: The September 11 terrorist attacks marked a turning point for radical right-wing movements. Since then, these political currents have adopted a violently anti-Islam rhetoric, positioning themselves as defenders of a so-called 'Judeo-Christian West.'

His lawyer is requesting his transfer to France.

Title: Are influencers out of touch? Their followers are starting to think so
Description: Like many content creators, French YouTuber Léna Situations has faced harsh criticism that she seems out of touch. Over the past 10 years, she has gone from being the best friend of her followers to a superstar. She recently hosted a live spectacle in front of some 20,000 people at Paris's Accor Arena.

Title: At space summit, France and EU rescue European satellite constellation Iris²
Description: Backed by France and the European Union, Iris² aims to deploy 348 satellites to offer secure communications services without relying on non-European providers. However, the public-private partnership faces several hurdles before it can be implemented.
